newsitem.title: USA: Sofamor will appeal patent ruling.
newsitem.headline: Sofamor will appeal patent ruling.

text.p: Sofamor Danek Group Inc said Thursday it will appeal a federal court ruling that a U.S. Surgical Corp unit did not infringe a Sofamor patent.

The U.S. District Court for the Central District of California ruled that U.S. Surgical's Surgical Dynamics Inc's Ray Threaded Fusion Cage does not infringe the Sofamor patent, U.S. Surgical said in an earlier statement.

"The court's ruling does not affect the existing competitive environment, nor does it change our future business strategy," Sofamor chairman and chief executive officer Ron Pickard said in a written statement.
"The ruling has not invalidated Sofamor's patent," he said.
The company will pursue the appeal immediately with the hope of winning the right to a trial on the matter, it said.
